verdict.rationale: Kit's own V4 API covers a substantial share of the UI: broadcasts can be created, updated and deleted, and the API also handles tags and custom fields, brand colors, account and broadcast stats, webhooks and bulk operations, with a remote MCP exposing account data for read and write. However, Kit makes no parity claim, and many UI features listed on its pricing page have no evidenced API equivalent; bulk processing covers only "some common use cases." Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage for visual automations, A/B testing, landing page and form building, polls, digital products/subscriptions, RSS campaigns and collaborative editing, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
